hints.menuType: Category of the Sequencer database animation.
hints.enableCustom: Plays the file or database path below instead of the selected animation.
hints.customPath: A video or image file, or a Sequencer database path such as jb2a.fireball.explosion.orange.
hints.contrast: Raises the contrast of the effect. 0 leaves it unchanged.
hints.saturate: -1 removes all color, 0 leaves it unchanged, 1 makes colors stronger.
hints.hue: Rotates every color around the color wheel, in degrees. 0 leaves it unchanged.
hints.tintColor: Color the effect is tinted with.
hints.tintSaturate: -1 removes all color, 0 leaves it unchanged, 1 makes colors stronger.
hints.file: Sound file, or a Sequencer database path.
hints.startTime: Where playback starts in the file, in milliseconds.
hints.size: Size of the effect, relative to the token. 1 is the token's size.
hints.scale: Size of the effect, relative to the token. 1 is the token's size.
hints.breathMin: Smallest size of the breathing pulse, in grid squares.
hints.breathMax: Largest size of the breathing pulse, in grid squares.
hints.breathDuration: Milliseconds from the smallest to the largest size.
hints.alphaMin: Lowest opacity of the pulse, from 0 to 1.
hints.alphaMax: Highest opacity of the pulse, from 0 to 1.
hints.alphaDuration: Milliseconds from the lowest to the highest opacity.
hints.switchType: On: when the target is out of reach, plays the matching ranged animation instead. Custom: plays the ranged animation chosen below. Off: always plays the melee animation.
hints.detect: Automatic: out of reach means beyond the token's reach. Manual: beyond the distance below.
hints.range: Distance in grid squares beyond which the ranged animation plays. Manual detection only.
hints.distance: How far the token moves, in grid squares.
hints.motionScale: Size of the token at the peak of the pulse. 1.2 is 20% larger.
hints.height: How high the token floats, in percent of its size.
hints.duration: How long it lasts, in milliseconds.
hints.onlyOnHit: Plays only on targets that were hit, when the system reports hits.
hints.label: Items whose name contains this name use this animation. Capitals and spaces don't matter.
hints.menu: Kind of animation: Melee and Range play from the source to the targets, On Token plays on a token, Templates on a placed template, Aura around a token, Preset is a ready-made sequence, Active Effects play while an effect is on a token. Changing it resets the Primary settings.
hints.activeEffectType: On Token: plays on the token. Aura: plays a circle around it.
hints.name: Name of a world macro, or Compendium.<scope>.<pack>.<macro name>.
hints.playWhen: Concurrent: the macro and the animation start together. Await Macro: the animation waits for the macro. Macro Only: no animation. Await Animation: the macro waits for the animation.
hints.args: Passed to the macro: values separated by commas, or an object in braces.
hints.exactMatch: Matches only items whose name is exactly this name.
hints.excludedTerms: Items whose name contains one of these words don't match this entry.
hints.enabled: Skips items whose property at the path equals the value, for example path type and value spell.
hints.particleType: Kind of particle effect, or a token animation.
hints.spritePath: Image or model used for the particles.
hints.arc: How high the particles arc on their way to the target.
hints.autoSize: Sizes the effect to the token.
hints.onCenter: Starts the effect from the token's center.
hints.rotateTowards: Turns the effect towards the target.
hints.rotationX: Rotation around the X axis, in degrees.
hints.rotationY: Rotation around the Y axis, in degrees.
hints.rotationZ: Rotation around the Z axis, in degrees.
hints.resetTime: Milliseconds before the token returns to its normal pose.
hints.source: Plays a token animation on the source token.
hints.sourcePlay: When it plays: at the start, at the end, or both.
hints.target: Plays a token animation on the targets.
hints.targetPlay: When it plays: at the start, at the end, or both.
hints.aboveTemplate: Draws the animation above lighting, darkness and fog (Sequencer's aboveLighting).
hints.addTokenWidth: Adds the token's width to the radius. Only with Radius.
hints.anchor: Anchor point of the effect, from 0 to 1: two numbers separated by a comma (x, y), or one for both. 0.5 is the center.
hints.animationSource: Experimental, D&D 5e and PF2e global entries only. Uses a placed persistent template animation as the source of the ranged attack, for spells like Black Tentacles. Needs a matching entry in both the Templates and the Range menu.
hints.checkCollision: Checks the path for walls, and doesn't move the token if it hits one.
hints.delayFade: Milliseconds before the token starts fading out.
hints.delayReturn: Milliseconds before the token returns to full opacity (at least 250).
hints.elevation: Below tokens: drawn under tokens. Above tokens: drawn over tokens, on the token's scene level.
hints.hideFromPlayers: Hides the range marker from players. Only a GM can change this.
hints.isMasked: Masks the effect to the token or template it plays on.
hints.isRadius: Scale: size relative to the token. Radius: radius in grid squares.
hints.isReturning: Plays the weapon's return animation, when the database has one.
hints.isWait: Delay: milliseconds before this part starts. Wait: the next part starts after this one finishes, plus these milliseconds (negative values overlap).
hints.life: How long each particle lasts, in milliseconds.
hints.occlusionAlpha: Opacity of the overhead tile while a token is under it.
hints.occlusionMode: How the overhead tile fades when a token is under it.
hints.onlyX: With a custom file: stretches the video only in length, keeping its height.
hints.opacity: Transparency of the effect, from 0 (invisible) to 1 (opaque).
hints.persistType: How the persistent effect is made: a Sequencer effect, a Sequencer effect attached to the template (it moves with it), an overhead tile, or a tile below tokens.
hints.persistent: Keeps the effect on the canvas until it is removed, for example with the Sequencer Effect Manager.
hints.playOn: Where the effect plays: on the source, on the targets, on the targets or the source when there are none, or on both.
hints.playbackRate: Playback speed of the video. 1 is normal speed.
hints.randomOffset: Moves the impact point to a random spot within the target.
hints.removeTemplate: Deletes the template right after it is placed.
hints.repeat: How many times it plays. 1 plays it once.
hints.reverse: Plays the animation from the target to the source.
hints.rotateSource: Turns the effect back towards the source token. Useful for JB2A side-impact effects.
hints.teleport: Teleports the token instead of moving it.
hints.unbindAlpha: Persistent effects only. When on, the effect's opacity follows the token's, overriding Opacity.
hints.unbindVisibility: Persistent effects only. When on, the effect is visible only while the token is; otherwise it is always visible.
hints.wait: Milliseconds after this part finishes before the next one starts. Negative values overlap.
hints.zIndex: Drawing order among effects at the same elevation and layer (below or above tokens): higher values are drawn on top.
hints.auraRadius: Radius of the aura, in grid squares.
hints.motionOpacity: Opacity the token fades to, from 0 to 1.
hints.templateScale: Scale of the effect: two numbers separated by a comma (x, y), or one for both. 1 fits the template.
hints.teleportAlpha: Opacity the token fades to while it moves, from 0 to 1.
hints.teleportSpeed: Movement speed, when the token isn't teleported.

diagnostics.info: May cause issues, depending on the player's trust level
diagnostics.tip1: Melee, Range, On Token and some Preset animations need targets, set with Foundry's targeting.
diagnostics.tip2: Turn on Debug in the Automated Animations settings, open the console (F12), and look for errors when an animation should play.
diagnostics.tip3: Check the menu entry that defines the animation, and that everything in it is filled in.
diagnostics.tip4: Use the Find the Culprit module to test with only Automated Animations, Sequencer and socketlib active.
diagnostics.tip5: Make sure your game system is supported.
diagnostics.tip6: Still not working? Open an issue on the Automated Animations GitHub repository.
